audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted the champion's own prose: it gave Tryndamere Levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, while whys[1], whys[2] and whys[5] all argue Shen wins exactly those stages.
audit.why: Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1) comes online at 2 and Spirit's Refuge at 3, which is the whole reason the text calls Level 3 'the full pattern'. The packet chart reads Tryndamere / Skill / Shen / Skill / Shen / Shen / Tryndamere and matches the prose and the 52.33% win rate over 1,395 games.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Tryndamere / Skill / Shen / Skill / Shen / Shen / Tryndamere in BOTH layers, ratings moved with it. Only Level 1 and the two-item stage belong to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid stated 'Track his R cooldown (90 seconds at rank 1 with no CDR)'. Undying Rage is 120/100/80.
audit.why: A wrong cooldown is worse than none: a player timing a 90-second window walks into an R that is still up for another 30 seconds. This is the single most punishable number in the matchup and the text built its best all-in window on it.
audit.corrected: 120 seconds at rank 1, carried into mid, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d alongside Spinning Slash's 12s and Shen's own 18s Shadow Dash / 200s Stand United.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout (W) was never mentioned anywhere in the matchup, in either layer.
audit.why: It cuts the attack damage of everyone around him and slows anyone whose back is turned — it is both his disengage against your walk-away and his chase tool after your taunt ends, on a 14s cooldown with no cost. Bloodlust (Q, 12s) is the heal that makes Grievous Wounds timing decide extended trades, per _missing/shen.json.
audit.corrected: Mocking Shout written into whys[3] as the reason Levels 4-5 stay a skill stage; Bloodlust named as the sustain that anti-heal answers.

audit.why: All three packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES: Spirit's Refuge and Stand United are Shen's real W and R, and 'Spinning Slashes' is just the plural of Spinning Slash. Left untouched.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are a genuine skill-check — Tryndamere builds Bloodlust stacks passively and can go all-in at any moment, so keep the wave closer to your side and don't extend. Every trade must start with W placement: if the spirit blade is not between you two before you E, abort the trade. At Level 6 the lane dynamic shifts entirely in your favour on the macro level — his Undying Rage locks him in a 5-second window of untouchability but also pins him to your lane, while Stand United lets you swing a bot-lane skirmish or save a collapsing mid-laner and return with full teleport credit. Force him to choose between matching your global pressure and farming his splitpush; he cannot do both. Track his R cooldown (90 seconds at rank 1 with no CDR): the window right after he blows it on a bad trade is your best all-in window in the lane.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Out-last it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1 — unkillable for 5s, out-last it before you commit. - Spinning Slash: 12s, his only escape from the taunt. - Shadow Dash: 18s — never spend it on chip. - Stand United: 200s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Out-last it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable for 5s on a 120s cooldown. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Both sides trade evenly but carefully — Tryndamere stacks Bloodlust passively, so freeze the wave near your tower and don't extend past the river.
edits.after: Even but careful — Mocking Shout (14s) cuts your AD and slows you when your back is turned, so it is his chase and his disengage: freeze near tower.

notes: The kit file tags Mocking Shout with a 'projectile' flag; Riot's own description is an area cry with no travelling missile, so I did NOT write anything about blocking or dodging it — treat the flag as a tooltip-parsing misfire. Undying Rage's 5-second duration is repeated from the existing text and matches the standard value, but the kit file does not list durations, so it is unverified from the data I was given. Whether Shen's taunt can hold Tryndamere through Undying Rage's spin-away, or how tenacity affects it, is not in Riot's text and I left it alone.
